code='''def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=min((x for x in cnt if x!=bg and x!=0),key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c]==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    variants=[]
    for reflect in (False,True):
      for k in range(4):
        q=set()
        for r,c in shape:
          if reflect:c=-c
          for _ in range(k):r,c=c,-r
          q.add((r,c))
        mr=min(r for r,c in q); mc=min(c for r,c in q)
        q=frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in q)
        if q not in variants:variants.append(q)
    for q in variants:
      dh=max(r for r,c in q); dw=max(c for r,c in q)
      for i in range(h-dh):
       for j in range(w-dw):
        cells=[(i+r,j+c) for r,c in q]
        if all(a[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
         for r,c in cells:a[r][c]=marker
    return a
'''
